page.layout: One printed page, with the running head at the top. One text block of roman type with the date line and two closing lines of the letter (the signature set to the right). A woodcut ornament sits below the text. No marginal notes. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.

main_text.p: que in T. E. observatia testimonium & tuarum laudum praedicationis conatum & symbolum extare volui quod ut grato benignóque animo T. E. accipiat obnixè precor. Dominus Deus solus, Æternus Sapiens, Bonus, Iustus, Misericors, te velut alterum Danielem, Spiritu suo corroboret ac confirmet, & ad Ecclesię suę praesidium diutissimè felicissimèque nobis, & toti Belgio incolumem cōseruet. Geneuę Cal. Augusti Anno temporis ultimi.

page.notes: The date line reads CIↃ IↃ LXXVII in the old numeral form, given as MDLXXVII. The "Geneuę" spelling and the printed "ultimi." are kept as printed. The ornament below the text is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is left out.
